set: LEGO Technic 42175 Volvo EC230 Electric Excavator (excavator booklet, bags 12-17)

input.model_so_far: Undercarriage with turntable and cylinder (steps 1-34) and the separate beam assembly (steps 35-46).

what_each_new_part_touches: The assembly built in steps 35-46 is attached to the front of the frame (two green arrows, magnified red box): its beam pushes onto the grey pin of the frame side and its yellow-end post goes to the cylinder side.
where_everything_is_after: the beam assembly is fixed to the front of the frame

why.problem_solved: Joins the new front unit to the machine.
why.why_these_parts: Two pins (green arrows) give a firm, square fit.
why.sets_up_for_later: Step 48 puts a 15-hole beam across the front.

review_note: The picture shows two arrows but not which holes they use.
